mechanism.base: Wood grows because water reaches it, the old texts say. Rain comes down, the ground takes it in, and the forest rises on what it drank. Nothing green stands without a source under it. The deeper the water, the taller the trunk it can feed, and every leaf is water that learned to stand.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Wood, the rain has nothing to raise and pools where it lands. What you feel and know stays under the surface. Say one true thing out loud every day.
mechanism.friction_turn: With too much Wood, the forest drinks faster than the rain can fall, and every word you give away leaves you drier. Sleep on one thing you meant to say.

function.definition_catalyst: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Wood makes it grow, so what you let out keeps building. As a catalyst, the growth runs short. Your warmth and your boldest ideas reach people early, and little comes after to carry them further.
function.definition_friction: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Wood sets it growing, and whatever you say keeps reaching. As a friction, the gate never gets to close. You spend yourself on how the moment feels, and little is left over for later.
function.definition_balanced: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Wood makes it grow, so what you let out keeps building. In balance, the gate opens at your pace. Your warmth and your ideas take root and grow, and enough stays inside to feed what comes next.
function.advise_catalyst: Much of what you make never leaves your hands, and the slow work behind it stays hidden. Take one idea you dropped last year one step further. Tell one person about a plan you have kept quiet. Let one small project grow for a month before you judge it.
function.advise_friction: Seek Metal, the Mind energy. Metal is the blade that trims a growing thing, and the strength returns to its root. Let it prune what Wood spreads. Nothing you let out will fill you back up. Bring one piece to its end before you begin the next. Drop one plan this month for good.
function.advise_balanced: Your work reaches people at a steady pace, and it keeps that pace while each new piece grows out of the one before. Take one idea you dropped last year one step further. Let one small project grow for a month before you judge it.

candidates.cta_verdict: You put more into what you make than you ever say about it, and what you make usually outgrows the plan.

catalyst.clause: The rain has nothing to raise and pools where it lands.
catalyst.remedy: Say one true thing out loud every day.

friction.clause: The forest drinks faster than the rain can fall.
friction.remedy: Sleep on one thing you meant to say.

wide.clause: Wood is easy for you to reach, and the rain in you keeps it growing.
wide.remedy: Use it. Make one thing a week and show it.

missing.clause: No green rises from your water, and the days pass with nothing new to show for them.
missing.remedy: Borrow it. Sit in on a class or make beside a friend.

spared.clause: No green draws on the water, and the source stays full for you.
spared.remedy: Keep it so. Take in before you give out.

thin.clause: Wood stays small in you, a few shoots the water can afford to feed.
thin.remedy: Keep it small. One thing made a month is enough.

excess.clause: Wood grows thick while the water under it sinks lower with each thing you start.
excess.remedy: Start nothing new for a month. Rest and let yourself fill up.

retired_2026-09-21_overlaps.mechanism.friction_turn: Run heavy, the rain never closes: everything that stands still gets watered, depth drained into other people’s forests. Close the sky sometimes. Rain is also allowed to rest.
retired_2026-09-21_overlaps.carry.friction.clause: The rain never closes: everything that stands still gets watered, depth drained into other people’s forests.

__ore.retired_bonds_dip: People grow near you and cannot always say why: that is your rain at work.
__ore.retired_fn_body: The Voice is your expression function: the gate where inner depth becomes outer growth. With Wood running it, expression in you cultivates: you speak in seeds, questions, and quiet suggestions that turn out to be load-bearing a year later. Your influence is climate more than announcement. Claim some of the harvest aloud. Forests forget which rain raised them.
__ore.retired_base_personal: Your core is Water, and Water feeds Wood: rain raises the forest. Whatever your depth pours itself into becomes your Expression, the channel where what you know underneath turns into visible growth. Every person mentored, every idea seeded, every project quietly watered is your rain, standing up as someone’s forest. Depth shows itself as what it grows.

backlog_dips_tg_pattern.mind: Explaining a thing plants it deeper in you: taught knowledge roots twice.

__ore.retired_v3_definition_catalyst:
Wood is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is your depth showing up as things that grow: people mentored, ideas seeded, projects that stand up and keep growing after you step back. You are built to develop others.

The junior who got promoted still quotes you. The idea you gave away is thriving under someone else’s name, and honestly it pleases you, because what you plant mattering more than what you hold is the whole shape of your gift.

Influence, for you, is slow, patient, and alive. Take one mentee, one junior, one growing thing, and give it a standing hour a week. Seed ideas freely and follow up seasonally. Keep a quiet list of what you have grown.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_friction:
Wood is your Expression, and as a friction, it is pouring into everything that stands still: every person developed, every idea watered, your depth spent raising gardens you do not live in.

Everyone’s mentor, no one’s project. The advice flows daily, the intros get made, the drafts get reviewed, and at the end of the month there is nothing with your own name on it and little water left either.

Generosity without limits feeds no one well for long. Count what you are currently growing, keep the three that matter, and let the rest go. Decline one mentorship ask a month. Water something of yours first, every single week.
